run_f_gold: run f_gold to add 1 to a given number using the bitwise NOT trick
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple integer inputs to verify it correctly adds 1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the bitwise NOT trick with a standard x + 1 expression
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how -(~x) is equivalent to adding 1 to x
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which adds 1 to an integer using bitwise negation and unary minus
